Test a robust weighted combination using softmax_neg_error over the full model pool to counter unstable ranking and high correlation groups.
The series is trend-dominated with unstable ranking; a robust DBA over the full pool may improve stability.
test a simple weighted inverse_error on the full pool to see if a more aggressive weight scheme outperforms DBA, given ranking instability but strong trend.
The series is trend-dominated with unstable ranking (tau≈0.1), so a robust non‑parametric aggregator like median over the full pool may outperform weighted schemes.
The series is trend-dominated with unstable ranking; a robust trimmed mean over the full pool may reduce impact of outlier models.
Test a forward-selection based weighting on the full pool to capture complementary models when ranking is unstable.
Use a robust weighted combo on the reduced pool4 (trend/seasonal models) with softmax on error to balance the strong DWT_rf and weaker others, testing a different weighting scheme.
Test a per‑horizon weighted combination on the full pool to exploit possible horizon‑specific model strengths in this trend‑dominated series.
The series is trend-dominated with unstable ranking; a simple robust mean over the full pool may beat the current DBA leader by averaging diverse models.

decision.justification: Selected 'dba' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9696. Series context: trend strength 0.6618 and seasonal strength 0.1567; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.096); 2 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.756.
